data.name: Suchita
data.gender_notes: Suchita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’ meaning good and ‘chit’ meaning knowledge or consciousness. It is the embodiment of wisdom and beauty. The name Suchita carries the meaning “Good, Wise, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Suchita usually hope their child will grow to embody good, wise, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment, knowledge, and inner wisdom.
data.etymology: Suchita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Wise, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suchita total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
